env: A multi-GPU x86 host with Docker, NVIDIA Container Toolkit, and NGC access to `nvcr.io/nvstaging/vss-core/vss-rt-cv` plus `nvstaging/vss-warehouse/vss-warehouse-app-data`. The VSS repository is checked out at `{{repo_root}}`, and the build skill writes to a fresh self-contained build directory under `{{repo_root}}/_builds/rt-cv-person-detection-rtdetr/` (or the next suffixed collision-resolved folder). The target data shape uses the warehouse sample set `nv-warehouse-4cams` plus the RT-DETR warehouse ONNX bundled in the warehouse app-data resource. The generated deployment must stay self-contained under `_builds/` and must not modify upstream compose files under `deploy/docker/`.

expects.query: Use the `/vss-build-vision-agent` skill to generate an RT-CV detection/tracking deployment on `{{platform}}` from `{{repo_root}}`. Submit this exact prompt to the skill: "Create a profile for generating bounding box cv metadata (object detection and tracking) of persons using RT-DETR." Choose a new build under `_builds/`, keep the generated output self-contained, and do not edit `SKILL.md`.
checks: `{{repo_root}}/_builds/` contains a new RT-CV detection/tracking build folder with `compose.yml`, `.env.template`, `MANIFEST.md`, and `allow-list.yml`.
The generated architecture and allow-list resolve to the required components: VIOS + RT-CV + ELK + Kafka.
The generated allow-list includes the RT-CV services contributed by `integrate-vss-detection-tracking-2d.md`, including `perception-2d-fusion`.
The generated output references patched copies under `_builds/<name>/patched/`, not upstream compose files directly.
No upstream compose file under `{{repo_root}}/deploy/docker/` is modified by generation.
The architecture proposal or manifest describes RT-DETR detection/tracking metadata to Kafka and Elasticsearch, including person-focused filtering support.
